conv.about: P(team): the share of 3,000 simulated rests of the season in which he is in his group's top two on WAR (forwards top six, defencemen top four), the games left at this season's own rate. No voter model, no market.
conv.label: All-Star

races.about: P(lead): the share of 3,000 simulated rests of the season in which he leads the league in points (goals break a tie), rates blended toward last season. As-of test 2011-2026 at a quarter, half and three quarters of the season: the favourite had 53% on average and led 24 of 48 times.
races.label: Art Ross

races.about: P(lead): the share of 3,000 simulated rests of the season in which he leads the league in goals, rates blended toward last season. As-of test 2011-2026 at a quarter, half and three quarters of the season: the favourite had 62% on average and led 30 of 48 times.
races.label: Rocket Richard
